top_signals.title: Tech Under Pressure on AI Jitters, Dollar Slips: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Technology shares came under renewed pressure as sentiment toward the artificial intelligence trade remained jittery ahead of key earnings this week that will test the strength of gains in chip stocks.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
